keyFindings.description: B6. retire() deletes the armed entry before awaiting retireUnconfirmedBoot; a cancelAll() (daemon dispose) or same-token cancel landing during that await cannot flip `cancelled`. When the retirement then rejects, the catch correctly declines to re-insert (!this.disposed) but returns false and watch() continues while(!cancelled): another full interval with real timers (controller.signal never aborted), probeAlive (list-panes), and a second retireUnconfirmedBoot -> mutateClaim -> persist() after the daemon's final save; same for a superseded watch (this.armed.has(token)). Pre-round-3 the loop always returned after the retire. Contradicts cancelAll()'s contract ('no background timer may outlive the watchdog'). Reproduced three times. Production exposure bounded (every cancelAll() path is followed by process exit before the 120 s interval) but a reproduced defect in code this PR adds, in the lifecycle-hygiene class the PR is about. Fix: `if (cancelled || this.disposed || this.armed.has(token)) return true;` before the re-insert; one sibling test row asserting no probe/retire after cancelAll().
